meta.name: Jezero Crater EVA Dataset
meta.note: Illustrative mock data for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Only the Octavia E. Butler landing site is an approximate real-world location; every other coordinate, hazard and dose value is invented.

base.name: Base Habitat — Jezero Alpha
base.description: Pressurised surface habitat with airlock, O2 recharge umbilical and long-range comms. All EVA traverses start and end here.

pois.name: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
pois.description: Approximate landing location of the Perseverance rover. Useful navigation landmark and hardware salvage site.

pois.name: Waypoint ECHO — Cache Depot
pois.description: Mock supply cache: two spare O2 canisters, repair kit and a beacon.

pois.name: Waypoint FOXTROT — Comms Relay
pois.description: Mock line-of-sight relay mast covering the north-east sector.

pois.name: Emergency Shelter ES-1
pois.description: Inflatable emergency shelter with a 48-hour O2 supply (mock).

pois.name: Delta Front Sediments
pois.description: Layered fan-delta deposits. Prime biosignature search target.

pois.name: Séítah Ridge Outcrop
pois.description: Olivine-rich igneous unit. Radiometric dating candidate.

pois.name: Phyllosilicate Outcrop
pois.description: Clay-bearing exposure indicating past liquid water.

pois.name: Carbonate Rim Sample Site
pois.description: Margin carbonates that may preserve ancient atmospheric chemistry.

pois.name: Lava Tube Skylight Candidate
pois.description: Possible skylight into a lava tube: natural radiation shelter and microbial refuge. Approach the escarpment with caution.

pois.name: Ancient Lakebed Mudstones
pois.description: Fine-grained lacustrine mudstones with organic-preservation potential.

radiationZones.name: Solar Particle Hotspot ALPHA
radiationZones.description: Thin regolith over bedrock, poor shielding. Avoid prolonged exposure.

radiationZones.name: Thin-Regolith Hotspot BRAVO
radiationZones.description: Exposed plateau with elevated secondary neutron flux.

radiationZones.name: Flare Exposure Gap CHARLIE
radiationZones.description: Open valley aligned with solar-flare particle direction. Do not enter.

slopeZones.name: Delta Scarp
slopeZones.description: Steep delta margin with loose talus.

slopeZones.name: Central Dune Ridge
slopeZones.description: Loose, wind-blown sand with slip faces.
